{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df_clean['revenue_numeric'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

mean_revenue"}
